items.question: How long does a set last?
items.answer: Two to three weeks with glue, two or three days with the adhesive tabs. What ends a set is usually one nail lifting at the edge rather than the whole set failing at once, and a lifted nail can be re-glued in about a minute.

items.question: Will they fit my nails?
items.answer: Every box holds twelve sizes, which covers most hands. Fit each nail dry before any glue goes on and pick the one that meets both sidewalls without pressing into them. If a nail sits between two sizes, take the larger and file the edges down.

items.question: Can I reuse a set?
items.answer: Yes, and that is the point of them. Soaked off properly the nails come away undamaged, and the same set will go back on four or five times. Sets removed by pulling do not survive.

items.question: Do they damage your own nails?
items.answer: Not if they come off the way they are meant to. Damage comes from pulling a press-on that is still stuck, which takes a layer of your nail with it. Ten minutes in warm oil first and nothing tears.

items.question: Can I shower, wash up and swim in them?
items.answer: Showering and washing up are fine. Long soaks in hot water are what loosens glue, so a bath or a swim will shorten the wear. Gloves for washing up will add days to a set.

items.question: Can I file them shorter or change the shape?
items.answer: You can take length off and reshape the free edge with a fine file before you wear them. Filing into the painted surface will cut through the top coat, so stay at the tip.

items.question: Do you make custom sets?
items.answer: Yes. Custom work starts from a photograph of your hands and a reference, and takes two to three weeks depending on the design. Write to the studio and we will come back with a sketch and a price.

items.question: When does the shop open?
items.answer: October. Sets are made in small runs and the first run is a dozen or so of each — Amour, which is a different picture on every nail, is six. Join the waitlist and you will get one email the day it opens, nothing else.

items.question: Where do you ship?
items.answer: Denmark first, then the rest of the EU. Everything is made and packed in Copenhagen.

items.question: What if a set arrives damaged?
items.answer: Photograph it before you remove anything from the box and write to the studio the same week. A set that arrives broken is replaced or refunded, and you do not need to send it back.
